score_definitions.RWDID: Binary 0/1 component scores weighted by the 15 training-set Cox beta coefficients and divided by their algebraic sum.
score_definitions.RWDID_C: Equal-weight sum of 15 continuous proportional component scores, each bounded between 0 and 1.

continuous.scoring_function: Linear rise to 1 at lower cutpoint; 1 within interval; linear decline to training P99
continuous.outside_support_rule: Clamp intake to training-derived P1-P99 before applying the frozen function
continuous.missing_rule: NA; no imputation; total NA unless all 15 components observed
